WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    player.death_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hall_of_fame.player_id) as hof_count
  FROM hall_of_fame 
  JOIN player ON hall_of_fame.player_id = player.player_id
  GROUP BY player.death_state
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(hof_count) as avg_count FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.death_state,
    step1.hof_count,
    step1.hof_count - step2.avg_count as difference
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step1.hof_count > step2.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(hof_count) as avg_hof_count,
  AVG(difference) as avg_difference
FROM step3
